title: English is just over half of released records
scope: All 86 source shards; no additional filters
takeaway: English accounts for 52.5%; language-specific conclusions need their own scope.

title: Model versions are mixed across the release
scope: All 86 source shards; model family aggregation
takeaway: This is a mixture of model generations, not a snapshot of one current assistant.

title: Collection volume varies strongly over time
scope: All records; month of source timestamp
takeaway: More records in a month reflect collection volume, not necessarily more users or greater demand.

title: Most records contain one user message
scope: All source records; counted stored user messages
takeaway: 83.5% contain one stored user message; that does not describe a person's complete AI usage.

title: English records have a long text-length tail
scope: English-labeled records; total words per role per record
takeaway: Median total user text is 176 words; large pasted inputs contribute to the upper tail.

title: A row-random sample is closer to the census
scope: Two separate 20,000-record samples compared with the full release
takeaway: The original block sample differs most in month/model mix; full-release counts now replace sample estimates.

title: Writing and information lookup lead task labels
scope: Microsoft released classifications aligned row-by-row to the pinned release
takeaway: AI classifications describe stored content; label accuracy has not been human-validated in this audit.

title: Topic labels span many domains
scope: Microsoft released classifications aligned row-by-row to the pinned release
takeaway: AI classifications describe stored content; label accuracy has not been human-validated in this audit.

title: Interpersonal content has several distinct forms
scope: 2,000 rows sampled uniformly without replacement; final request classified using stored history
takeaway: 31 of 2,000 final requests are labeled personal help; a social topic alone does not establish a real relationship event.

title: Text work also dominates the 2,000-request sample
scope: 2,000 uniformly selected records; final active request is the annotation unit
takeaway: These final-request labels use a different unit and taxonomy from Microsoft whole-record labels.

title: Most exact metadata combinations occur once
scope: Exact hashed IP + accept-language + user-agent; all three components nonblank
takeaway: 156,930 combinations occur in multiple records; a repeated combination does not establish identity.

title: Most repeated combinations have short spans
scope: Repeated complete metadata combinations only; latest minus earliest record timestamp
takeaway: 66 combinations span at least one year; their identity, continuous use and topic continuity are not established.
